title: MissingMoebTool signals omitted for Read and ToolSearch in fix_signal run
description: External Claude Code tools Read and ToolSearch were called during this fix_signal invocation â€” Read to consume the oversized MCP result file (fix_signal prompt output exceeded inline limits), ToolSearch to load deferred moeb tool schemas. Per moeb-tool-origin policy each external tool call must be followed immediately by a buffered MissingMoebTool signal. No such signals were written in this run.
proposed_resolution: The fix_signal skill should instruct the agent to buffer MissingMoebTool signals immediately after any external tool use, before the next phase begins. A moeb tool that streams large MCP results inline (or a pagination mechanism for oversized outputs) would eliminate the need for Read. A built-in schema-preload step in fix_signal would eliminate the need for ToolSearch.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000057: ToolSearch is a legitimate pre-skill bootstrapping tool (no moeb equivalent needed); moeb-tool-origin rubric needs updating to exempt it.
